Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de autovehicule
Responsibilities
You are an important part of our project teams and responsible for Cybersecurity Engineering activities
Security and Privacy Management according to standards like ISO 21434 or comparable
Identify assets, perform a security risk analysis (TARA) and perform attack path modelling (ATA)
Create a technical cybersecurity concept including security controls (like secure SW update and Secure communication)
Perform vulnerability analysis
Negotiating with direct customer contact Cybersecurity Agreements (CIA) and identify together with the customer the suitable security protection for the product
Assist project team members in security design and implementation
Plan your activities in an agile environment and contribute to the success of the project
 You are also part of
Product Security Incident Response team (PSIRT) to overcome existing vulnerabilities in products in field
Continuously improve our cybersecurity expertise. Platform-thinking, reusability, efficiency
 Candidate profile
7+ years of experience of cybersecurity- or SW engineering in automotive industry or comparable
Knowledge in cryptographic primitives and functions, security controls and cybersecurity methodologies
Knowledge in the standard ISO 21434 or comparable cybersecurity standards of other industries
Degree in computer science, engineering or comparable
Self-motivated, keen on communication and problem solving, conceptual thinking
Ability to work on your own after introduction phase into our department and company
Experience in the field of embedded engineering, automotive ECUs, SW Engineering experience or knowledge about AUTOSAR will be an advantage
 What We Offer
Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
Opportunity to work on innovative products and technologies used by leading international customers
Access to modern development tools, laboratories and testing environments
Technical and professional development through training, certifications and knowledge-sharing initiatives
International collaboration with engineering teams across the Marquardt Group
Attractive compensation package including 13th salary, meal vouchers and annual bonuses
Comprehensive benefits package covering medical services, sports & wellness, culture, education, tourism and more
Long-term career development within a global technology company
 About Marquardt R&D Center Sibiu
 The Marquardt R&D Center in Sibiu has been developing innovative technologies and products since 2008.
Our engineering teams work on software development, hardware design, mechanical engineering, testing and validation, contributing to products used by some of the world's leading automotive manufacturers.
By combining innovation, technical excellence and teamwork, we help shape the technologies of tomorrow.
 About Marquardt Romania
 Marquardt is a globally operating family-owned technology company with more than 8,000 employees worldwide. In Romania, our Production facilities, R&D Center and Business Services organization work together to develop, manufacture and support innovative solutions for leading international customers.
Driven by innovation, teamwork and continuous improvement, we create technologies that shape the future of mobility and beyond.
